ei.title: How the Internet Reshaped Fashion Retail
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: The internet has transformed the fashion marketplace, making it increasingly difficult to predict the demand for the selling season. Consumers can browse for product information and prices and gain comparative information almost instantaneously, making them more informed than ever before, transferring the balance of power from the retailer to the customer. This is exacerbated by open and real-time access to fashion shows, facilitated through livestreaming, coupled with social media access to celebrity looks and lifestyles and the sharing of all aspects of life on social media. Consumers use fashion choices to express their individual style and personality, especially those promoting 'brand me' on social media. The traditional two-season offer is no longer seen as enough, with consumers demanding new products throughout the whole year. This creates a problem for fashion retailers as many consumers are looking for more exclusive pieces to differentiate themselves, forcing up the desire for trend-led ever more rapidly changing styles, while still demanding affordable prices.

questions.passage: The internet has ①<u>transformed</u> the fashion marketplace, making it increasingly difficult to predict the demand for the selling season. Consumers can browse for product information and prices and gain comparative information almost instantaneously, ②<u>make</u> them more informed than ever before, transferring the balance of power from the retailer to the customer. This is exacerbated by open and real-time access to fashion shows, ③<u>facilitated</u> through livestreaming, coupled with social media access to celebrity looks and lifestyles and the sharing of all aspects of life on social media. Consumers use fashion choices to express their individual style and personality, especially those ④<u>promoting</u> 'brand me' on social media. The traditional two-season offer is no longer seen as enough, with consumers demanding new products throughout the whole year. This creates a problem for fashion retailers as many consumers are looking for more exclusive pieces to differentiate themselves, forcing up the desire for trend-led ever more rapidly changing styles, while still demanding affordable prices.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①transformed(변화시켰다) ②make(만들며←making) ③facilitated(촉진된) ④promoting(홍보하는)
det.analysis:
❌ ① transformed: has + 과거분사(현재완료). 인터넷이 패션 시장을 '변화시켰다'로 적절
✅ ② make: 분사구문에서 동사원형은 부적절. 앞 절의 결과를 나타내는 분사구문이므로 making이 맞음 ←정답
❌ ③ facilitated: 과거분사. 패션쇼 접근이 라이브스트리밍으로 '촉진된'으로 적절
❌ ④ promoting: 현재분사. those(= consumers) promoting에서 '홍보하는'으로 적절
det.tip: 분사구문: making them more informed (결과의 분사구문)

questions.passage: The internet has transformed the fashion marketplace, making it increasingly difficult to predict the demand for the selling season. Consumers can browse for product information and prices and gain comparative information almost instantaneously, making them more ①<u>informing</u> than ever before, transferring the balance of power from the retailer to the customer. This is exacerbated by open and real-time access to fashion shows, facilitated through livestreaming, ②<u>coupled</u> with social media access to celebrity looks and lifestyles and the sharing of all aspects of life on social media. Consumers use fashion choices to ③<u>express</u> their individual style and personality, especially those promoting 'brand me' on social media. The traditional two-season offer is no longer ④<u>seen</u> as enough, with consumers demanding new products throughout the whole year. This creates a problem for fashion retailers as many consumers are looking for more exclusive pieces to differentiate themselves, forcing up the desire for trend-led ever more rapidly changing styles, while still demanding affordable prices.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①informing(알리는←informed) ②coupled(결합된) ③express(표현하다) ④seen(여겨지는)
det.analysis:
✅ ① informing: 'making them more informing'에서 소비자가 정보를 '받는' 상태이므로 과거분사 informed가 맞음. informing(능동)은 부적절 ←정답
❌ ② coupled: 과거분사. '~와 결합된'으로 적절
❌ ③ express: to부정사 목적. 스타일을 '표현하기 위해'로 적절
❌ ④ seen: 수동태 'is seen as'. '~로 여겨지는'으로 적절
det.tip: informed(정보를 받은 상태, 수동) vs informing(정보를 주는, 능동)

questions.passage: The internet has transformed the fashion marketplace, making it increasingly difficult to predict the demand for the selling season. Consumers can browse for product information and prices and gain comparative information almost instantaneously, making them more informed than ever before, ①<u>transferring</u> the balance of power from the retailer to the customer. This is ②<u>exacerbated</u> by open and real-time access to fashion shows, facilitated through livestreaming, coupled with social media access to celebrity looks and lifestyles and the sharing of all aspects of life on social media. Consumers use fashion choices to express their individual style and personality, especially those promoting 'brand me' on social media. The traditional two-season offer is no longer seen as enough, with consumers ③<u>demanding</u> new products throughout the whole year. This creates a problem for fashion retailers as many consumers are looking for more exclusive pieces to differentiate themselves, ④<u>forced</u> up the desire for trend-led ever more rapidly changing styles, while still demanding affordable prices.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①transferring(이전하며) ②exacerbated(악화되다) ③demanding(요구하는) ④forced(강제했다←forcing)
det.analysis:
❌ ① transferring: 분사구문(결과). 권력의 균형을 '이전하며'로 적절
❌ ② exacerbated: 수동태 'is exacerbated by'. '~에 의해 악화되다'로 적절
❌ ③ demanding: 'with + O + V-ing' 구문. 소비자들이 '요구하는'으로 적절
✅ ④ forced: 앞 절의 결과를 나타내는 분사구문이므로 forcing이 맞음. forced(과거형)는 주절 동사와 병렬 불가 ←정답
det.tip: forcing up = 결과의 분사구문 (~하면서/~하여)

questions.passage: The internet has transformed the fashion marketplace, making it increasingly difficult ①<u>to predict</u> the demand for the selling season. Consumers can browse for product information and prices and gain comparative information almost instantaneously, making them more informed than ever before, transferring the balance of power from the retailer to the customer. This is exacerbated by open and real-time access to fashion shows, facilitated through livestreaming, coupled with social media access to celebrity looks and lifestyles and the ②<u>sharing</u> of all aspects of life on social media. Consumers use fashion choices to express their individual style and personality, especially ③<u>them</u> promoting 'brand me' on social media. The traditional two-season offer is no longer seen as enough, with consumers demanding new products throughout the whole year. This creates a problem for fashion retailers as many consumers are looking for more exclusive pieces to differentiate themselves, forcing up the desire for trend-led ever more rapidly changing styles, while still ④<u>demanding</u> affordable prices.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ them → those: those promoting = those (who are) promoting (지시대명사+분사)
det.analysis:
❌ ① to predict: 가목적어 it + 형용사 difficult + to부정사(진목적어). 적절
❌ ② sharing: 'the sharing of'에서 동명사의 명사적 용법. 적절
✅ ③ them: 'especially those promoting'에서 those = those consumers(~하는 사람들). them은 목적격 대명사로 분사 promoting의 의미상 주어가 될 수 없음 ←정답
❌ ④ demanding: 'while still demanding'에서 분사구문(동시동작). 적절
det.tip: those promoting = those (who are) promoting (지시대명사 + 분사)

questions.passage: The internet has transformed the fashion marketplace, making it increasingly difficult to predict the demand for the selling season. Consumers can ①<u>browse</u> for product information and prices and gain comparative information almost instantaneously, making them more informed than ever before, transferring the balance of power from the retailer to the customer. Consumers use fashion choices to express their individual style and personality, especially those promoting 'brand me' on social media. The ②<u>traditional</u> two-season offer is no longer seen as enough, with consumers demanding new products throughout the whole year. This creates a problem for fashion retailers as many consumers are looking for more exclusive pieces to ③<u>assimilate</u> themselves, forcing up the desire for trend-led ever more rapidly changing styles, while still demanding ④<u>affordable</u> prices.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①browse(둘러보다) ②traditional(전통적인) ③assimilate(동화시키다←differentiate) ④affordable(저렴한)
det.analysis:
❌ ① browse: 소비자가 제품 정보를 '둘러보다' → 적절
❌ ② traditional: '전통적인' 두 시즌 제안 → 적절
✅ ③ assimilate: 소비자가 자신을 '동화시키다'는 '차별화하다(differentiate)'라는 원문과 모순 ←정답
❌ ④ affordable: '저렴한' 가격을 요구한다 → 적절
det.tip: differentiate(차별화하다) ↔ assimilate(동화시키다)

questions.passage: The internet has transformed the fashion marketplace, making it ①<u>increasingly</u> difficult to predict the demand for the selling season. Consumers can browse for product information and prices and gain comparative information almost instantaneously, making them more informed than ever before, transferring the balance of power from the retailer to the customer. This is exacerbated by open and real-time access to fashion shows, facilitated through livestreaming, coupled with social media access to celebrity looks and lifestyles and the sharing of all aspects of life on social media. This creates a problem for fashion ③<u>retailer</u>s as many consumers are looking for more exclusive pieces to differentiate themselves, forcing up the ④<u>desire</u> for trend-led ever more rapidly changing styles, while still demanding affordable prices.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①increasingly(점점 더) ②conceal(숨기다←express) ③retailer(소매업자) ④desire(욕구)
det.analysis:
❌ ① increasingly: 수요 예측이 '점점 더' 어려워진다 → 적절
✅ ② conceal: 패션 선택으로 스타일을 '숨기다'는 '표현하다(express)'라는 원문과 모순 ←정답
❌ ③ retailer: 권력이 '소매업자'에서 고객으로 이동 → 적절
❌ ④ desire: 트렌드 주도 스타일에 대한 '욕구' → 적절
det.tip: express(표현하다) ↔ conceal(숨기다)
